literal.prompt: Какое соглашение Россия и Речь Посполитая заключили в 1618 году для прекращения боевых действий сроком на 14,5 лет?

literalGroups.primaryGround: The prompt is limited to a named agreement between Russia and the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth concluded in 1618 for a 14.5-year term; the Deulino article states the Russian and Polish delegations concluded that truce on 1 (11) December 1618 for 14.5 years (L45). The four labels are all documented agreements: Deulino truce (L45), Nerchinsk Russia-China treaty (L44), Brest peace treaty (Articles 1 and signature, L18 and L82), and Paris peace treaty ending the Crimean War (L51). These contexts make Deulino the unique fit.
literalGroups.locator: PRlib Deulino turn1view0 L44-L47; PRlib Nerchinsk turn1view1 L40-L45; U.S. State Dept turn3view0 L14-L18,L78-L82; PRlib Crimean War turn3view3 L44-L51

literalGroups.literal: Деулинское перемирие заключили 1 (11) декабря 1618 года после боевых действий России и Речи Посполитой. Его срок составил 14,5 лет.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The official library article dates the agreement 1 (11) December 1618, identifies the Russian and Polish delegations, and gives the term as 14.5 years (L45). It also describes the 1617-18 military actions that preceded it (L44).

literalGroups.literal: По его условиям Россия уступила Польше Смоленские земли, кроме Вязьмы, Черниговские и Новгород-Северские земли.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The same Deulino account states that the truce required Russia to cede Smolensk (except Vyazma), Chernigov and Novgorod-Seversky lands to Poland; this is a concrete additional fact about the correct option, beyond the asked date, parties and term (L45).

literalGroups.literal: Нерчинский договор 1689 года стал первым договором России с Китаем.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The Presidential Library identifies the Nerchinsk agreement of 27 August (6 September) 1689 as the first treaty between Russia and China (L44), supporting the note’s defining fact about this distractor.

literalGroups.literal: Брест-Литовский мир 1918 года вывел Советскую Россию из Первой мировой войны.
literalGroups.primaryGround: Article 1 of the complete treaty text says the state of war between Russia and the four Central Powers ceased; the signature line dates it at Brest Litovsk, March 3, 1918 (L18,L82). Article 5 independently supports the note’s demobilization fact (L39).

literalGroups.literal: Парижский мирный договор 1856 года завершил Крымскую войну.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The complete returned Presidential Library article explicitly says the Crimean War ended with the Paris peace treaty signed 18 (30) March 1856 (L51), directly supporting this distractor note.
